q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom coffee sleeves?
a: The smallest order is one pack of 100 printed sleeves for $30.00, and you can order up to 50 packs (5,000 sleeves) straight from any product page. That suits a single cafe or a one-off event as well as a regular restock. Runs over 5,000 sleeves, or orders with special finishes such as embossing or a custom die cut, are priced by quote.

q: How long does it take to receive my order?
a: Production takes 7-10 business days after you approve your digital proof. Shipping within the United States then takes 3-7 business days and is free, so most orders arrive 10-17 business days after proof approval. If you have a fixed date, tell us before you order and we will confirm whether it can be met. Quick Tip: Approve your design quickly to ensure faster processing. We'll send you a digital proof for approval before printing.

q: Do you offer free design services?
a: Yes! We provide complimentary design services with every order. Our experienced design team will work with you to create the perfect artwork for your coffee sleeves. Simply provide us with your logo, brand colors, and any specific design requirements, and we'll create a professional design at no extra cost. You'll receive a digital proof for approval before production begins.

q: What materials are the coffee sleeves made from?
a: We print on kraft paper, white cardboard, corrugated board and recycled-content paper. Kraft gives a natural brown look, white board shows bright full-color artwork, and corrugated board adds a fluted layer for extra insulation on very hot drinks. The sleeve sits on the outside of the cup and never touches the drink. We can help you choose based on your brand look, budget and how your drinks are served.

q: Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order?
a: Every order starts with a free digital proof, so you see exactly how your design sits on the sleeve before anything is printed and before you pay. If you want to try the fit first, the smallest order is a single pack of 100 sleeves, which is an easy way to test a material and size on your own cups before a bigger run. Fit Tip: Send us your cup size with its top and bottom diameter, and we match the sleeve template to it on your proof.

q: What cup sizes do your sleeves fit?
a: Our standard coffee sleeves fit the most common cup sizes: 8oz, 12oz, 16oz, and 20oz. We also offer custom sizing for specialty cups or unique requirements. The sleeves are designed with flexibility to fit a range of cup diameters comfortably. If you have specific cup measurements, our team can create custom-sized sleeves to ensure a perfect fit.

Our sleeves are paper-based: kraft, white board, corrugated board and recycled-content paper. An uncoated paper sleeve can usually go in paper recycling where your local program accepts it, while heavy coatings and laminates make that harder. If lower impact matters to your brand, choose kraft or recycled-content stock and keep finishes light, and we will tell you plainly what your sleeve is made of.

We offer full-color digital printing (CMYK), offset printing for large quantities, and specialty finishes including gloss, matte, spot UV, and embossing. You can print on one or both sides of the sleeve. We support complex designs, gradients, photographs, and multiple colors, and full-color printing is included in the $30.00 price for 100 sleeves. Popular Choice: Full-color printing on kraft paper creates a beautiful, rustic look that's trending with modern cafes.

q: How much do custom coffee sleeves cost?
a: Printed sleeves are $30.00 for 100, with free design help, a free digital proof and free shipping within the United States. Choose your quantity on any product page in packs of 100, up to 5,000 sleeves, and pay by PayPal or bank transfer invoice once you approve your proof. Only runs over 5,000 sleeves or special finishes are priced by quote.

q: What if my sleeves arrive damaged or misprinted?
a: If your sleeves arrive defective, damaged in transit or misprinted against the proof you approved, email us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and photos. We send a free replacement or a refund and cover any shipping. Because every order is printed to your approved design, we cannot take sleeves back for a change of mind. Approved refunds are issued within 10 business days.

q: Can I reorder the same design in the future?
a: Absolutely! We keep all your design files on record for easy reordering. Simply reference your previous order number, and we can reproduce your exact design without any setup fees. Reorders are typically processed faster since the design is already approved. This makes it convenient to maintain consistent branding across multiple orders. Tip: Mention your previous order number and we send a fresh proof to confirm before printing.
